name: elitea-desktop
description: The desktop client: a Tauri 2 host around the elitea-web desktop build (ADR-0029); branded at build time (ADR-0052)

scripts.dev: npm run brand && tauri dev --config src-tauri/tauri.brand.json
scripts.build: npm run brand && tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.brand.json
scripts.build:debug: npm run brand && tauri build --debug --bundles app --config src-tauri/tauri.brand.json
